subject: Modelling 2 sources of replicates in bilat.symmetry()

messages.subject: Modelling 2 sources of replicates in bilat.symmetry()
parts:
Hi all,

I'm looking to run a procurstes anova to model the effects of measurement error alongside the a few other variables (the standard ind,side adn indi*side). I have 4 pictures per person, and 2 digitizations of each picture, so have 2 sources of measurement error. However Bilat.symmetry only seems to allow me to model 1 using the 'replicates' argument. Is there any way to do both?

thanks,

Richie
